machine.processor: 13th Gen Intel Core i5-13400F (6 performance and 4 efficient cores, 16 threads)
machine.system: Windows 11 Home, WSL2, Ubuntu 22.04.2 LTS, kernel 5.15.133.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2
machine.load: the processor's total load, logged every minute through the run: median 23%, 90% of the minutes at or below 40%, 0% to 100%. CGAL and Qhull, unchanged since the run of 2026-10-14, read 6 to 10% slower in it (the median over their rows): the times are those of a slower state of the machine, and the ratios within a row, whose libraries take turns, are what compares

libraries.CGAL: 5.4 (Ubuntu libcgal-dev 5.4-1), Epick in D = 2 and 3, Epick_d above
libraries.Qhull: 2020.2.r 2020/08/31, qconvex and qdelaunay with i s TI <file> TO <out>

method: benches/compare/README.md: the libraries of a row take turns; 5 rounds of 3 builds when the first library's first build is under 1.5 s, otherwise 3 rounds of 1; one build a process for Qhull. Times are the construction of the output, timed inside each library's process. Peaks are ru_maxrss of three processes that build once, read by GNU time.
